name: contradiction_vs_consistency_paired
description: Paired ASNE contrast with matched wording for matching versus differing scene information.

consistent_information.text: A person reads that the meeting is in Room 204. The door label also says Room 204.
Someone reads that the package belongs in Bin A12. The scanner screen also says Bin A12.
A person reads that the train leaves from Platform 5. The station board also says Platform 5.
Someone reads that the appointment is Tuesday at 3. The desk card also says Tuesday at 3.

contradictory_information.text: A person reads that the meeting is in Room 204. The door label says Room 317.
Someone reads that the package belongs in Bin A12. The scanner screen says Bin B44.
A person reads that the train leaves from Platform 5. The station board says Platform 9.
Someone reads that the appointment is Tuesday at 3. The desk card says Friday at 10.
